title: Festivities in Ayodhya
introduction: On the wish of King Dasaratha, Vasishta goes to Rama's palace and asks him to perform fast that night along with Seetha. Vasishta returns to Dasaratha's palace and informs him about this. On the way to the king's palace Vasishta observes the festive atmosphere in Ayodhya anticipating Rama's coronation the next day.
closing: || इत्यार्शे स्रीमद्रामायने आदिकाव्ये अयोध्यकान्दे पन्चम सर्गः ||
Thus completes 5th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
सन्दिश्य रामं नृपतिः श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने |
पुरोहितं समाहूय वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sandiśya rāmaṃ nṛpatiḥ śvobhāvinyabhiśhecane |
purohitaṃ samāhūya vasiśhṭhamidamabravīt
verses.translation: After Rama left, king Dasaratha called for his family priest Vasishta and spoke to him as follows about the ensuing anointment ceremony of the next day.

verses.devanagari:
गच्छोपवासं काकुत्थ्सं कारयाद्य तपोधन |
श्रीयशोराज्यलाभाय वध्वा सह यतव्रतम्
verses.iast:
gacchopavāsaṃ kākutthsaṃ kārayādya tapodhana |
śrīyaśorājyalābhāya vadhvā saha yatavratam
verses.translation: "O, great sage Vasishta! Please go to the avowed Rama and Seetha today to make them perform fasting for obtaining prosperity, glory and sovereignty."

glosses.meaning: who is with daughter in law Seetha

verses.devanagari:
तथेति च स राजानमुक्त्वा वेदविदां वरः |
स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान् ययौ रामनिवेशनम्
उपवासयितुं रामं मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रकोविदः |
ब्राह्मं रथवरं युक्तमास्थाय सुदृधव्रतः
verses.iast:
tatheti ca sa rājānamuktvā vedavidāṃ varaḥ |
svayaṃ vasiśhṭho bhagavān yayau rāmaniveśanam
upavāsayituṃ rāmaṃ mantravanmantrakovidaḥ |
brāhmaṃ rathavaraṃ yuktamāsthāya sudṛdhavrataḥ
verses.translation: Vasista, who is the best of knowers of Veda, who is expert in mantras, who is firm in austerities and who is divine, said to Dasaratha : "I agree to it" and personally went to Rama's house on a chariot which was ready and quite suitable for a Brahman; so as to advise Rama to undertake a fast (with mantras) performed by Rama, a knower of mantras.

glosses.meaning: who is the best of knowers of Veda
which was well suited for Brahmans

verses.devanagari:
स रामभवनं प्रप्य पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रभम् |
तिस्रः कक्ष्या र्थेनैव विवेश मुनिसत्तमः
verses.iast:
sa rāmabhavanaṃ prapya pāṇḍurābhraghanaprabham |
tisraḥ kakśyā rthenaiva viveśa munisattamaḥ
verses.translation: That great sage reached Rama's house, which was radiant like a dense white cloud and entered the three gateways of the house by the chariot itself.

glosses.meaning: which was radiant like a dense white cloud

verses.devanagari:
तमागतमृषिं रामस्त्वरन्निव ससंभ्रमः |
मानयिष्यन् स मानार्हं निश्चक्राम निवेशनात्
verses.iast:
tamāgatamṛśhiṃ rāmastvaranniva sasambhramaḥ |
mānayiśhyan sa mānārhaṃ niścakrāma niveśanāt
verses.translation: To respect the honorable sage, who arrived, Rama came quickly and hurriedly out of the house.

verses.devanagari:
अभ्येत्य त्वरमाणश्च रथाभ्याशं मनीषिणः |
ततोऽवतारयामास परिगृह्य रथात्स्वयम्
verses.iast:
abhyetya tvaramāṇaśca rathābhyāśaṃ manīśhiṇaḥ |
tato'vatārayāmāsa parigṛhya rathātsvayam
verses.translation: Rama quickly got nearer to Vasishta's chariot and personally helped him to alight from the chariot.

glosses.meaning: and by personally holding his hand

verses.devanagari:
सचैनं प्रश्रितं दृष्ट्वा सं भाष्याभिप्रसाद्य च |
प्रियार्हं हर्षयन् राममित्युवाच पुरोहितः
verses.iast:
sacainaṃ praśritaṃ dṛśhṭvā saṃ bhāśhyābhiprasādya ca |
priyārhaṃ harśhayan rāmamityuvāca purohitaḥ
verses.translation: That family priest Vasishta seeing that lovable and humble Rama, spoke the following words, bringing cheerfulness and happiness to him:

verses.devanagari:
प्रसन्नस्ते पिता राम यौवराज्यमवाप्स्यसि |
उपवासं भवानद्य करोतु सह सीतया
verses.iast:
prasannaste pitā rāma yauvarājyamavāpsyasi |
upavāsaṃ bhavānadya karotu saha sītayā
verses.translation: "O, Rama! Your father is delighted with you. You will be getting the princely kingdom. Hence, you and Seetha perform fasting today."

verses.devanagari:
प्रातस्त्वामभिषेक्ता हि यौवराज्ये नराधिपः |
पिता दशरथः प्रीत्या ययातिं नहुषो यथा
verses.iast:
prātastvāmabhiśhektā hi yauvarājye narādhipaḥ |
pitā daśarathaḥ prītyā yayātiṃ nahuśho yathā
verses.translation: "Your father; King Dasaratha is anointing you affectionately for the princely kingdom tomorrow at dawn; even as king Nahusha has done to Yayati".

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्त्वा स तदा राम मुपवासं यतव्रतम् |
मन्त्रवत् कारयामास वैदेह्या सहितं मुनिः
verses.iast:
ityuktvā sa tadā rāma mupavāsaṃ yatavratam |
mantravat kārayāmāsa vaidehyā sahitaṃ muniḥ
verses.translation: Vasistha thus spoke to Rama and enjoined him to undertake a vow of fasting together with Seetha, in the accompaniment of mantras.

verses.devanagari:
ततो यथावद्रामेण स राज्ञो गुरुरर्चितः |
अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य काकुत्थ्सं ययौ रामनिवेशनात्
verses.iast:
tato yathāvadrāmeṇa sa rājJṇo gururarcitaḥ |
abhyanujJṇāpya kākutthsaṃ yayau rāmaniveśanāt
verses.translation: Thereafter, Rama worshipped the royal priest Vasistha suitably. Vasistha then got Rama's permission and left his house.

verses.devanagari:
सुहृद्भिस्तत्र रामोऽपि सहासीनः प्रियंवदैः |
सभाजितो विवेशाथ ताननुज्ञाप्य सर्वशः
verses.iast:
suhṛdbhistatra rāmo'pi sahāsīnaḥ priyaṃvadaiḥ |
sabhājito viveśātha tānanujJṇāpya sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Rama spent some time by delightedly talking with friends and having been congratulated by them in various ways went into his palace after taking leave of them.

verses.devanagari:
हृष्टनारीनरयुतं रामवेश्म तदा बबौ |
यथा मत्तद्विजगणं प्रपुल्लनलिनं सरः
verses.iast:
hṛśhṭanārīnarayutaṃ rāmaveśma tadā babau |
yathā mattadvijagaṇaṃ prapullanalinaṃ saraḥ
verses.translation: Then, Rama's house was shining, as brilliantly with delighted men and women, as a lake filled with opened lotuses and visited by innumerable happy birds.

verses.devanagari:
स राजभवनप्रख्यात्तस्माद्रामनिवेशनात् |
निर्गत्य ददृशे मार्गं वसिष्ठो जनसंवृतम्
verses.iast:
sa rājabhavanaprakhyāttasmādrāmaniveśanāt |
nirgatya dadṛśe mārgaṃ vasiśhṭho janasaṃvṛtam
verses.translation: Vasishta, leaving Rama's house, which seemed like the royal palace, saw the way filled with people.

verses.devanagari:
बृन्दबृन्दैरयोध्यायां राजमार्गाः समन्ततः |
बभूवुरभिसंबाधाः कुतूहलजनैर्वृताः
verses.iast:
bṛndabṛndairayodhyāyāṃ rājamārgāḥ samantataḥ |
babhūvurabhisambādhāḥ kutūhalajanairvṛtāḥ
verses.translation: All the royal highways in the city of Ayodhya were filled with groups and groups of delighted people and became congested.

verses.devanagari:
जनबृन्दोर्मिसंघर्षहर्षस्वनवतस्तदा |
बभूव राजमार्गस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः
verses.iast:
janabṛndormisaṅgharśhaharśhasvanavatastadā |
babhūva rājamārgasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
verses.translation: Then, on the royal road, the resonance created by the rush of the people, moving hither and thither like waves, combined with their rejoicing, resounded like the roar of an ocean.

glosses.meaning: the sound created by the commotion of the people with their rejoicing

verses.devanagari:
सिक्तसंमृष्टरथ्या हि तदहर्वनमालिनी |
आसीदयोध्या नगरी समुच्छ्रितगृहध्वजा
verses.iast:
siktasaṃmṛśhṭarathyā hi tadaharvanamālinī |
āsīdayodhyā nagarī samucchritagṛhadhvajā
verses.translation: On that day, in the city of Ayodhya, all the roads were cleaned and sprinkled with water. There were rows of trees on both sides of the roads and flags hoisted on houses.

glosses.meaning: one with the roads cleaned and sprinkled with water
(and) one that has houses hoisted with flags.

verses.devanagari:
तदा ह्ययोध्यानिलयः सस्त्रीबालाबलो जनः |
रामाभिषेकमाकाञ्क्षन्नाकाण्क्षदुदयं रवेः |
verses.iast:
tadā hyayodhyānilayaḥ sastrībālābalo janaḥ |
rāmābhiśhekamākāJṇkśannākāṇkśadudayaṃ raveḥ |
verses.translation: Then, the people of Ayodhya including children, women and the old-aged were waiting for sunrise, wishing the anointment ceremony of Rama to happen.

verses.devanagari:
प्रजालङ्कारभूतं च जनस्यानन्दवर्धनम् |
उत्सुकोऽभूज्जनो द्रष्टुं तमयोध्यामहोत्सवम्
verses.iast:
prajālaṇ^kārabhūtaṃ ca janasyānandavardhanam |
utsuko'bhūjjano draśhṭuṃ tamayodhyāmahotsavam
verses.translation: In Ayodhya, people were enthusiastic to see the great public function, which was decorative to the community and which would bring forward an increased joy.

glosses.meaning: which was decorative to the community
and which would bring forward increased joy.

verses.devanagari:
एवं तं जनसंबाधं राजमार्गं पुरोहितः |
व्यूहन्निव जनौघं तं शनैराजकुलं ययौ
verses.iast:
evaṃ taṃ janasambādhaṃ rājamārgaṃ purohitaḥ |
vyūhanniva janaughaṃ taṃ śanairājakulaṃ yayau
verses.translation: Vasishta, thus seeing the king's way being overcrowded with people, reached the royal palace slowly by forcing a passage through that crowd.

verses.devanagari:
सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यं प्रासादमधिरुह्य सः |
समीयाय नरेन्द्रेण शक्रेणेव बृहस्पतिः
verses.iast:
sitābhraśikharaprakhyaṃ prāsādamadhiruhya saḥ |
samīyāya narendreṇa śakreṇeva bṛhaspatiḥ
verses.translation: He walked up the royal palace, which was akin to the top of a mountain enclosed by a white cloud and met king Dasaratha in the manner Brihaspati met Devendra.

glosses.meaning: which resembled the top of a mountain enclosed by white cloud

verses.devanagari:
तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य हित्वा राजासनं नृपः |
पप्रच्छ स च तस्मै तत्कृतमित्यभ्यवेदयत्
verses.iast:
tamāgatamabhiprekśya hitvā rājāsanaṃ nṛpaḥ |
papraccha sa ca tasmai tatkṛtamityabhyavedayat
verses.translation: Seeing Vasistha had returned, King Dasaratha alighted from his throne and asked him with regard to his mission. Vasistha informed him that it was accomplished.

verses.devanagari:
तेन चैव तदा तुल्यं सहासीनाः सभासदः |
आसनेभ्यः समुत्तस्थुः पूजयन्तः पुरोहितम्
verses.iast:
tena caiva tadā tulyaṃ sahāsīnāḥ sabhāsadaḥ |
āsanebhyaḥ samuttasthuḥ pūjayantaḥ purohitam
verses.translation: The members of assembly who were sitting along with the king till then, raised in obeisance to Vasishta from their seats, following the example of the king.

verses.devanagari:
गुरुणा त्वभ्यनुज्ञातो मनिजौघं विसृज्य तम् |
विवेशान्तःपुरं राजा सिंहो गिरिगुहामिव
verses.iast:
guruṇā tvabhyanujJṇāto manijaughaṃ visṛjya tam |
viveśāntaḥpuraṃ rājā siṃho giriguhāmiva
verses.translation: King Dasaratha, after obtaining permission from Vasishta, left that assembly of men and entered his palace as a lion enters a mountain cave.

verses.devanagari:
तमग्र्यवेष्प्रमदाजनाकुलं |
महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमं निवेशनम् |
विदीपयंश्चारु विवेश पार्थिवः |
शशीव तारागणसंकुलं नभः
verses.iast:
tamagryaveśhpramadājanākulaṃ |
mahendraveśmapratimaṃ niveśanam |
vidīpayaṃścāru viveśa pārthivaḥ |
śaśīva tārāgaṇasaṅkulaṃ nabhaḥ
verses.translation: That palace with women in top dress and form was like the palace of Devendra. By the entering of King Dasaratha, the palace became more radiant, just as the moon radiates a beautiful sky with its stars.

glosses.meaning: filled with women in top dress and form
